name: APG GDPR texts for forms
author: Art Project Group

sections.description:
APG GDPR texts for forms add the legal texts to adapt WordPress and WooCommerce to the GDPR.

Features

  • Fully customizable texts.
  • Includes the shortcode [privacy_policy] to add the link to the privacy page configured in the WordPress Privacy settings.
  • You can customize the privacy page if you don’t have it configured in WordPress Privacy settings.
  • Includes the shortcode [apg_rgpd] to be able to add the texts in any form.
  • Add legal texts in the WordPress comment form.
  • Fully compatible with Contact Form 7.
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce.
  • Fully compatible with the Checkout block of the WordPress block editor.
  • Fully compatible with WPML.
  • Adds the legal texts in the WooCommerce registration form.
  • Adds the legal texts in the WooCommerce product rating form.
  • Adds the legal texts in the WooCommerce checkout form.
  • Adds a button to delete the account in the WooCommerce Account Details form.

Translations

  • Español (Art Project Group).
  • English (Art Project Group).

Technical support

Art Project Group offers Technical support to configure or install APG GDPR texts for forms.

Origin

APG GDPR texts for forms has been programmed to meet our own needs and those of our customers when implementing the GDPR on their websites.

sections.installation:
1. You can:
    • Upload the folder apg-gdpr-texts-for-forms to the directory /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP.
    • Upload the full ZIP file via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload in the Administration Panel of your WordPress installation.
    • Search APG GDPR texts for forms in the search engine available on Plugins -> Add New and press Install Now button.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in the WordPress Administration Panel.
  3. Ready, now you can enjoy it, and if you like it and find it useful, make a donation.
sections.faq:
Configuration is needed?

The configuration is very simple since you will only have to customize the predefined texts that the plugin comes with.
